_comment: Critical journey for the tool-library fixture (a community tool library's online reservation). The walkthrough evaluator walks these steps; the analytical CW ground truth is in ground-truth.json (defects with a cw field). Test values only: FT-01234 is a fixture membership number and 07700 900123 is in Ofcom's drama range.
title: Reserve a drill for Saturday's session

persona.group: Library members reserving online for the first time
knows: the tool they want: the 18 V cordless drill that comes with two batteries
that tools are collected at the Saturday morning session
their membership number, FT-01234, and their mobile number
that there is a deposit, paid at the desk
does_not_know: that only the days marked 'Open' are sessions
how long the basket holds a tool for them
persona.context: On a phone on Thursday evening, planning Saturday's job, with a cup of tea going cold

goal: Have the drill with two batteries waiting at Saturday morning's session
scenario: You are putting up shelves on Saturday 17 October 2026 and want the cordless drill that comes with two batteries, for one week. Your membership number is FT-01234. Make sure it is reserved for you to collect at Saturday morning's session.

start_state.data: every tool is available from its listed date; the basket is empty

all.text: Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries

correct_actions.target: role=link[name="Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries"]
